commit.message:
Fix IDK conditioning silently skipping on released task files (#24)

The scorers looked up the answerability label as "answerability", but the
released generation task files for mtrag-human and mtrag-synthetic ship it
as "Answerability". The lookup returned an empty list, the label became
None, every label branch was skipped, and scoring fell through to the
unlabelled path.

This corrupted RL_F_idk_underspecified, RB_llm_idk_underspecified and
RB_agg_idk_underspecified in both directions: a correct abstention on an
UNANSWERABLE or CONVERSATIONAL item scored 0 instead of 1, and a failed
abstention scored rl_f instead of 0. Nothing raised -- the only signal was
a repeated "Error: answerability is None" print, 2526 lines for the 842-row
dev set, and the output files still contained plausible-looking values.

Read both casings via a single helper, and raise when the label is absent
rather than scoring the row anyway. The helper also guards against the
float NaN that pandas produces for a partially-present column, which is
truthy and would otherwise crash on subscript.

Also route get_idk_score through the helper; it carries the identical bug
and is currently unreachable, so fixing it now avoids a repeat.

Fixes #23

Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

@@ -98,11 +98,18 @@ def _llm_type(self):
 # ================================================
 # Get IDK conditioning score
 # ================================================
+def _get_answerability(row):
+    for key in ("answerability", "Answerability"):
+        vals = row.get(key)
+        if vals is None or isinstance(vals, float):  # absent, or pandas NaN
+            continue
+        return vals if isinstance(vals, str) else (vals[0] if len(vals) else None)
+    raise KeyError(f"No answerability label on task {row.get('task_id')!r}")
+
+
 def get_idk_score(row, use_metric):

+    answerability = _get_answerability(row)
     idk_eval = metrics.get("idk_eval")[0]
     rl_f = metrics.get(use_metric)[0]
